_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. config.json is gitignored — it is yours.
_save_dir_help: Absolute path to your TerraInvicta/Saves folder. Leave null to auto-detect (Windows, macOS/CrossOver, Linux/Proton, WSL).
_game_install_dir_help: Absolute path to the Terra Invicta install (the folder containing TerraInvicta_Data). Leave null to auto-detect from Steam library locations. Used by sync_game_data.py.
_faction_help: REQUIRED. Your faction templateName: ResistCouncil, ExploitCouncil, SubmitCouncil, AppeaseCouncil, CooperateCouncil, DestroyCouncil, EscapeCouncil. Scripts refuse to guess — set it (or pass --faction).
_anchor_nations_help: Your 3-5 key nations for trend tracking (campaign-log Tables E/H), as nation templateNames e.g. ["2026_USA", "2026_CHN", "2026_RUS"]. Leave null to auto-detect the top 3 nations by GDP among those where your faction holds a control point. Changing anchors mid-campaign breaks log-column comparability.
_research_rate_help: Your campaign's research-rate setting. In-game RP cost = template cost x (100 / this). At 200, costs are template / 2. Used by cost-computing scripts.
_alien_progression_help: Your campaign's alien-progression setting. Scripts read the live value from your save; this copy is a fallback and a hint for the AI agent's reasoning (event timing, hate math).
_difficulty_help: Cinematic, Normal, Veteran, or Brutal. Scripts read difficulty from your save; this copy is a fallback and a hint for the AI agent's reasoning (several constants are difficulty-keyed).
_scenario_help: DLC scenario overlay your campaign runs on: "2003_Scenario" (Dark Skies 2003 start) or "Broken_Earth_Scenario"; null = default 2026 start. setup_campaign.py detects it from the save. sync_game_data.py layers <install>/DLC_Content/<DLC>/<scenario>/Templates over the base templates — without it, scenario-only effects (e.g. the 2003 start's x0.5 CP research penalty) are invisible to the analyzers.
_mods_help: Which mods sync_game_data.py layers onto the templates: "enabled" = everything in <install>/Mods/Enabled (what the game actually loads), a list of mod folder names, or false for none. Only template-file mods (TI*Template.json, TIGlobalConfig.json, *.en) affect the analyzers; code (.dll) mods cannot be mirrored.
